stem: Beacon Bank classifies customer checkout as tier-1 production and internal QA as tier-3 nonproduction with tighter budget limits.

choices.text: Run checkout in multiple AZs and keep QA on scheduled smaller capacity.
Deploy checkout and QA in one Availability Zone with the same instance count at all times
Run checkout in one AZ with pilot-light recovery scripts and run QA in two AZs
Mirror production multi-AZ capacity in QA at all times

rationale: Tiered availability design maps high-impact production to multi-AZ resilience and lower-impact QA to leaner scheduled capacity. One-AZ deployment for checkout misses production availability expectations. Using pilot-light recovery while keeping checkout in one AZ still leaves production outside the stated high-availability class. Fully mirroring production capacity in QA can add unnecessary cost without matching business impact.
